conspiracy: what the media will not tell you

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(mainstream media|msm)\s+(is hiding|will never tell you|blackout|refuses to report)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Media Suppression Tropes
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Weaponizes institutional distrust by claiming information is being systematically concealed by journalists.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Omnipotent Puppet-Master Archetype
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Attributes complex geopolitical or economic events to a singular omnipotent hidden orchestrator.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Event Invalidation & False Flag Reflex
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Reflexively dismisses real-world tragedies or kinetic events as simulated theatrical deceptions.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Biological & Existential Extermination Plot
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Alleges covert mass poisoning or extermination programs conducted by medical/state institutions.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Biosecurity Conspiracy Vector
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Frames epidemiological outbreaks as deliberate synthetic attacks rather than natural phenomena.

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(stolen election|rigged voting machines|ballot dumping|algorithm switched votes)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Electoral De-legitimization Vector
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Attacks the democratic transition of power by asserting systemic algorithmic vote switching without evidence.

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(great reset|you will own nothing|new world order|un agenda)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Globalist Enslavement Grand Narrative
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Synthesizes disparate regulatory policies into a master conspiracy of global totalitarian enslavement.

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(5g radiation|microchip in the vaccine|quantum dot tracking)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Technological Subjugation Myth
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Fabricates invisible electronic or biological tracking mechanisms inside public infrastructure.

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(controlled opposition|all puppets of|bought and paid for by)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Universal Complicity Trope
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Dismisses nuanced disagreements by claiming all public figures are actors in a scripted theater.

conspiracyPatterns.pattern: \b(connect the dots|do your own research|open your eyes|wake up sheeple)\b
conspiracyPatterns.name: Epistemic Flattery & Pattern-Seeking Prompt
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Flatters the reader's intellect while inviting pareidolia and associative illusion.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Occult Demonization Trope
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Dehumanizes political opponents by invoking ancient blood libel and occult demonology narratives.

conspiracyPatterns.name: Meteorological & Atmospheric Weaponization Myth
conspiracyPatterns.explanation: Attributes natural weather disasters and wildfires to secret directed-energy weapons.
